# Session — 2026-04-15 00:00

## What we were working on
Polymarket weather bot — full issue resolution pass. Started by auditing all open problems from prior sessions and fixing everything code-fixable. Ran the 60-day backtest interactively, discovered that `between`-bracket markets destroy EV while `exact`-type (single temperature) markets are marginally profitable. Ran a 48-combination parameter sweep filtered to `exact` only and found that `hours_before=2` is the critical variable (EV=+0.02/Kelly=3.5% at 2h vs EV=-0.05 at 7h). Built and wired `question_type_filter` and `time-to-resolution gate` into the live scanner. Also fixed a startup `ImportError` caused by `src/polybot/` shadowing the installed `telegram` package in `sys.path`.

## Open problems

Problems are ordered **critical → high → medium → minor**.

---

### Critical

- [ ] `CRIT-001` — **USDC allowance on CLOB proxy wallet unverified.** `approve_usdc.py` has been fixed (was showing $0 due to wrong field name) but the on-chain allowance state has not been confirmed. Bot cannot place live orders if allowance is 0. **How to verify solved:** `uv run python scripts/approve_usdc.py` prints a non-zero balance and at least one approved contract with "unlimited" or `$X.XX` allowance; subsequent bot run produces no `PolyApiException[status_code=400]` errors in `bot.log`.

- [ ] `CRIT-002` — **Weather settlement data source unknown.** Polymarket weather markets reference a specific authority (Weather.com, AccuWeather, or national met) for the official high temperature. Open-Meteo grid-point data can differ by 2–5°C. The exact+2h strategy shows EV=+0.02 despite this — possibly because exact markets settle on a round integer where small errors don't matter — but this remains unconfirmed. **How to verify solved:** At least one resolved market's rules page explicitly names the settlement source; `estimate_probability` produces a model temp within ±0.5°C of settled value on ≥80% of past exact markets.

---

### High

- [ ] `HIGH-001` — **Live orders never placed.** Bot has `LIVE_TRADING=true` but `grep "LIVE ORDER PLACED" data/trades/bot.log` returns zero results. Prior root cause (stale JSONL driving balance to -$220) was fixed; USDC allowance fix was applied. Needs a confirmed live scan cycle to validate the full execution path. **How to verify solved:** `grep "LIVE ORDER PLACED" data/trades/bot.log` returns ≥1 result after next run; Polymarket wallet shows an open position.

- [ ] `HIGH-002` — **Low CLOB price hit rate.** 60-day backtest: 90/135 = 66.7% CLOB hit rate (target ≥85%). 45 markets with valid parse and resolution silently dropped because `_clob_price_before_resolution` returns None. Likely causes: markets closing faster than the 7h window covers, or token IDs pointing to NO tokens. No diagnostic logged per skip. **How to verify solved:** CLOB hit rate ≥85% in the backtest summary, or a "CLOB miss reason" log line appears for each skipped market explaining why.

- [ ] `HIGH-003` — **above/below question types have insufficient backtest volume.** 60-day sweep shows only 1 `below` trade and 0 `above` trades — not enough to evaluate EV. These one-sided markets are theoretically more model-resilient than brackets. Either the parser misses them, volume is genuinely low, or the edge threshold filters them out. **How to verify solved:** `uv run scripts/backtest_weather.py 90` shows ≥5 trades each for `above` and `below` types in the "By Question Type" table.

---

### Medium

- [ ] `MED-001` — **City P&L dashboard widget not implemented.** The data exists (`TradeRecord.question` + `pnl_usd` on closed trades) and city aggregation exists in `backtest/engine.py`, but nothing surfaces in the Rich terminal or web dashboard during live operation. **How to verify solved:** After ≥5 closed weather trades, a ranked city P&L list appears in either the terminal or web dashboard showing city name, total P&L, and win rate.

- [ ] `MED-002` — **`sports_enabled` accidental activation risk.** If `SPORTS_ENABLED=true` is set without intending to run the sports scanner, the Odds API quota will be consumed on every scan. The live US client is properly guarded (`live_trading AND sports_enabled AND polymarket_key_id`), but the scan loop starts unconditionally when `sports_enabled=true`. **How to verify solved:** Adding a note or guard in `cli.py` that warns/skips sports scan if `odds_api_key` is unset or quota is near-exhausted; or verify instruction is deemed not applicable since the fix is a config discipline issue.

---

### Minor

- [x] `MIN-001` — **`SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS` not tuned.** `.env` currently has `SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS=100`; the session goal was to confirm `30` works. Open-Meteo and Gamma have no hard rate limits, so 30s is safe, but it has not been validated in a 10-scan run. **How to verify solved:** `SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS=30` set in `.env` and bot log shows 10+ consecutive scan completions without errors.

- [ ] `MIN-002` — **Pydantic v1 / Python 3.14 compatibility warning at startup.** `langchain_core` emits `UserWarning: Core Pydantic V1 functionality isn't compatible with Python 3.14 or greater` on every run. Not fatal, but noisy and indicates a dependency that will break on future Python upgrades. **How to verify solved:** `uv run src/polybot/cli.py 2>&1 | grep "Pydantic V1"` returns no output (either upgraded langchain_core or pinned Python < 3.14).
